cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

mechanism: A leads speech rehearsal by securing credit for an opening, then uses its accepted argumentative role to press for broader attribution while accommodating B authorship.
confusable: Generic credit demand lacks an agreed smaller contribution whose logic undermines exclusive authorship.
comparison: Windowsill alternative bargains over space and maintenance; this one negotiates intellectual credit and spoken acknowledgement.
seedUse: Opening paragraph seed gives exact concession; S02 needs an adjusted credit request instead of a metaphor about following text.
